messages.subject: Re: abundance effects in DISTANCE
parts:
On Tue, 26 Apr 2005 13:33:38 -0400, Richard Chandler wrote:

> >I'm wondering if there are plans to modify DISTANCE so that it can be
> >used to model abundance effects (in addition to detectability effects)
> >in the way described by Royle et al. Ecology 2004 85:1591 and,
> >apparently, Hedley and Buckland 2004? Thanks.

Hi Richard, list,

We are planning to extend Distance to include a new analysis engine based on
the count method of Hedley et al. (2004 - Chapter 4 of the Advanced Distance
Sampling book). This should hopefully be available by the end of 2005,
funding and time permitting.

In the longer term, we have a research project funded by the US Office of
Naval Research to further extend these methods to deal with problems cased by
(i) local clustering in density that cannot be accommodated by large-scale
smooths; (ii) extrapolating smooth surfaces into areas with no survey effort;
(iii) irregular topography. This project is due to be completed in June 2007.

- Len
